twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.subtitle: Protect your BabyCharts account with a second security factor.

twoFactor.scanQrTitle: 1. Scan QR code in Authenticator App
twoFactor.recoverySubtitle: Save these emergency codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your device.

growth.title: Growth Charts (WHO Percentiles)
growth.subtitle: Official WHO Child Growth Standards by age
growth.emptyDescription: Record your first measurement to visualize the WHO percentile curves for your child.
growth.legendP50Desc: Median: Exactly 50% of healthy children measure/weigh less and 50% more.
growth.legendNormalDesc: Main growth band: ~70% of all healthy children fall into this shaded area.
growth.legendP85Desc: Upper range: 85% of peers measure/weigh less.
growth.legendP97Desc: Upper edge: Only 3% of healthy children measure above this line.
growth.legendP3Desc: Lower edge: Only 3% of healthy children measure below this line.
growth.zoomPanTip: Tip: Use mouse wheel/pinch to zoom & drag (pan) or use the zoom buttons

health.subtitle: Track fever, symptoms, and medication history.

milestones.title: Developmental Milestones
milestones.subtitle: Track and celebrate first major milestones.
milestones.createCustomSubtitle: Create an individual developmental step for your child.

first-smile.title: First conscious smile
first-smile.desc: Reacts to familiar faces and voices with an affectionate smile.

hold-head.title: Hold head steady
hold-head.desc: Holds head steady and upright when lying on tummy.

roll-over.title: Roll tummy to back
roll-over.desc: First coordinated rolling movements around own axis.

first-solid-food.title: First solid foods
first-solid-food.desc: First spoons of purée or complementary foods.

sit-alone.title: Sit unsupported
sit-alone.desc: Can sit steadily without assistance and without toppling over.

crawl.title: Crawling / Scooting
crawl.desc: Explores the world moving on all fours.

pincer-grasp.title: Pincer grasp
pincer-grasp.desc: Picks up small objects using thumb and index finger.

pull-to-stand.title: Pull to stand
pull-to-stand.desc: Pulls up to standing position using furniture or rails.

stand-up.title: Pull up & stand with support
stand-up.desc: Pulls up to standing position independently using furniture or cot.

first-word.title: First spoken word
first-word.desc: Says the first purposeful word (e.g. Mama, Papa, Da).

first-words.title: First words (e.g. Mama, Dada)
first-words.desc: Uses specific words purposefully for people or objects.

first-steps.title: First independent steps
first-steps.desc: Takes the first brave steps completely unsupported!

first-birthday.title: 1st Birthday 🎂
first-birthday.desc: The first big birthday and the first candle on the cake.

stack-blocks.title: Stack building blocks
stack-blocks.desc: Successfully stacks several blocks on top of each other.

drink-cup.title: Drink from cup independently
drink-cup.desc: Drinks from a regular cup without help.

run.title: Running steadily
run.desc: Runs smoothly across the room or playground.

run-jump.title: Running & jumping with ease
run-jump.desc: Runs safely, climbs, and jumps with both feet.

potty-training.title: Potty training / Daytime dryness
potty-training.desc: Communicates needs and uses potty or toilet.

spoon-eating.title: Eat with spoon independently
spoon-eating.desc: Brings spoon to mouth securely without spilling much.

stairs-climbing.title: Climb stairs
stairs-climbing.desc: Walks up stairs while holding onto the railing.

kick-ball.title: Kick a ball
kick-ball.desc: Kicks a ball forward while standing without losing balance.

draw-lines.title: First scribbles & lines
draw-lines.desc: Holds crayons and draws lines on paper.

dress-self.title: Put on simple clothes
dress-self.desc: Puts on or takes off socks, hats, or shoes independently.

teeth.title: Teething Log
teeth.subtitle: Click on a tooth to record its eruption with date and notes.

vaccinations.title: Vaccination Record
vaccinations.subtitle: Document vaccinations according to recommended schedules.

rsv-prophylaxe.name: RSV Immunization (Nirsevimab)
rsv-prophylaxe.desc: Monoclonal antibody immunization to protect against severe respiratory syncytial virus infections.

rotavirus-1.name: Rotavirus (1st dose)
rotavirus-1.desc: Oral vaccination against severe gastrointestinal infections.

meningokokken-b-1.name: Meningococcal B (1st dose)
meningokokken-b-1.desc: Protection against invasive meningitis and sepsis caused by Meningococcal group B.

6fach-1.name: 6-in-1 Vaccine (1st dose)
6fach-1.desc: Diphtheria, Tetanus, Pertussis, Polio, Hib, Hepatitis B.

pneumokokken-1.name: Pneumococcal (1st dose)
pneumokokken-1.desc: Protection against severe pneumonia, meningitis, and ear infections.

meningokokken-b-3.name: Meningococcal B (3rd dose / Completion)
meningokokken-b-3.desc: Completion of primary immunization against Meningococcal B.

meningokokken-c.name: Meningococcal C
meningokokken-c.desc: Protection against meningitis caused by Meningococcal type C.

mmrv-2.name: MMRV (2nd dose / Completion)
mmrv-2.desc: 2nd dose for complete protection against MMR & Chickenpox.

hepatitis-a.name: Hepatitis A (Travel / Indication)
hepatitis-a.desc: Protection against infectious Hepatitis A for travel or specific health conditions.

influenza.name: Flu / Influenza (Seasonal)
influenza.desc: Seasonal protection against influenza for children with chronic conditions or increased risk.

uCheckups.title: Well-child Checkups (U1-U9)
uCheckups.subtitle: Official preventive checkup schedule U1 to U9.

U1.name: U1 (Newborn Initial Screening)
U1.desc: First vital signs, Apgar score, Vitamin K

U2.name: U2 (Basic Examination)
U2.desc: Full body examination, hearing screening, metabolic screening

U3.name: U3 (4th-5th Week)
U3.desc: Hip ultrasound, motor skills check, and weight gain monitoring

U4.name: U4 (3rd-4th Month)
U4.desc: Mobility, vision and hearing development, vaccination consultation

U5.name: U5 (6th-7th Month)
U5.desc: Targeted grasping, rolling over, active mobility

U6.name: U6 (1st Birthday)
U6.desc: Crawling, sitting unsupported, first words, language comprehension

U7.name: U7 (2nd Birthday)
U7.desc: Two-word sentences, walking, language and behavioral development

U7a.name: U7a (3rd Birthday)
U7a.desc: Vision check, dentition, 3-word sentences, social interaction

homeScreen.heroTitle: Your child's development at a perfect glance.
homeScreen.heroSubtitle: WHO growth charts, German U-checkup booklet, STIKO vaccination schedule, milk teeth diary, photo milestones, and pediatrician PDF reports – safely hosted on your own server.
homeScreen.card1Desc: Precise percentile analytics for weight, height, head circumference & BMI (0–5 years) with interactive zoom.
homeScreen.card2Desc: German yellow U-booklet with recommended time windows, doctor notes, and automatic appointment preview.
homeScreen.card3Desc: Official Standing Committee on Vaccination guidelines with dose tracking and timely reminders.
homeScreen.card4Desc: Interactive 20-tooth chart to document teething progress with eruption dates & personal notes.
homeScreen.card5Desc: Capture first steps, first smiles, and precious developmental moments with photo uploads and lightbox.
homeScreen.card6Desc: Shared family access via invite codes as well as structured PDF & Excel exports for pediatricians.
